Settings.title: Settings
Settings.intro: Tune how images are laid out. Settings are saved in a cookie on this device and apply to the next images you process.
Settings.paddingDescription: Space added on each side of the {size}px canvas. The product is fitted into the remaining <mono>{content}×{content}</mono> px.
Settings.thresholdDescription: Share of the sampled edge and center pixels that must be white for an image to get the padded white-background layout. Lower it if product shots on white aren't detected; raise it if photos are padded by mistake.
